 Order
16.02.2024 Order No.
05. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.58 of 2023 pending on the file of learned Addl. Sessions Judge- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Kendrapara, arising out of Kendrapara Town P.S. Case No.187 of 2023 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 376-D/376-A/506/353/366 of IPC and 6 and 4 of the POCSO Act.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge- cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Kendrapara
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned ADJ-cum-Spl. Judge (POCSO), Kendrapara by order dated 29.09.2023 in the aforementioned case,
the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. Perused the 164 Cr.P.C. statement of the victim.
6.
Considering the same, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application at this stage.
